publishedRecipe.name: Turkey Vegetable Stir-Fry with Carrot & Cilantro-Tossed Rice Noodles

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes or according to package directions.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
2 red bell peppers
4 medium carrots
1 small bunch cilantro
1 lime

instructions.primary_message: Trim, halve, and small dice zucchini; trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place both in a large bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallots and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the other veggies.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add veggies, turkey, and pepper. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ lb ground turkey
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; place in the reserved bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the carrot and set aside.

When the turkey is done, add soy sauce, honey, and chili-garlic sauce to the skillet; stir to combine. Continue to cook until veggies are tender and sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes more; remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup soy sauce
2 tbsp honey
2 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: When the noodles are done, drain and rinse under cool water. Add to the bowl with the carrot and cilantro.
Juice lime into the bowl, add oil, and toss to combine.
To serve, divide noodles and turkey vegetable stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
